subject: maths
question: Four runners started running simultaneously from a point on a circular track. They took 280 seconds, 350 seconds, 420 seconds and 560 seconds, respectively, to complete one round. After how much time (in seconds) do they meet at the starting point for the first time?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find when multiple runners meet at the starting point for the first time, simply calculate the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of their individual lap times.

Required Time = LCM(280, 350, 420, 560)

We can factor out the common divisor 70 to make it easier:

Required Time = 70 × LCM(4, 5, 6, 8)

The LCM of 4, 5, 6, and 8 is 120.

Required Time = 70 × 120 = 8400 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 8400 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Runner 1 (T₁) = 280 s

Time taken by Runner 2 (T₂) = 350 s

Time taken by Runner 3 (T₃) = 420 s

Time taken by Runner 4 (T₄) = 560 s
